title: Just Yeasty American Dough Bowl
description: A crispy, yeasty American dish featuring a long-fermentation dough and a vegetable stock cube, perfect for a quick snack or light meal. This low-sodium-friendly recipe is cooked in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, and sugar.
Gradually add the water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled earthenware bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Dissolve the vegetable stock cube in 1 tablespoon of hot water.
Brush the risen dough with the olive oil and sprinkle with the dissolved stock cube and salt.
Bake the dough in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until it is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the dough from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
